{{Quote|Control, shuttle ''Narrow Margin''. We are gear up and on our way to our next rally. May the Force be with you.|Shuttle ''Narrow Margin''|<ref name="SWG:operations" />}}
The '''''Narrow Margin''''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|hero]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to travel to the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Accompanied by a group of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance commandos]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] attempted to rally support for the Rebel cause and recruit [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for dangerous missions against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Narrow Margin'' was based off of the unremarkable design of [[passenger shuttle]]s commonly used throughout the many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, unlike the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] which were ostensibly used only for [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] travel between [[City/Legends|cities]], the ''Narrow Margin'' was able, whether through its own capabilities or through other means, of being delivered between multiple planets. Metallic [[Color/Legends|gray]] with red stripes, the ''Narrow Margin'' had four [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] on each side of the craft, and an elevated canopy containing the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. The rear of the craft contained the ship's two [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and a large boarding hatch. The craft also used a single retractable skid as a landing gear.<ref name="SWG:operations" />

==History==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the ''Narrow Margin'' was used to carry the Rebel Alliance [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|hero]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and an accompaniment of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance commandos]]. Luke Skywalker and [[Gender/Legends|his]] Rebel compatriots traveled aboard the shuttle to a number of [[City/Legends|cities]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in an effort to rally support for the Rebel cause. Although they were nominally controlled by the Empire, the cities of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] were at times occupied by the Rebel Alliance. During these periods of Rebel occupation, the ''Narrow Margin'' had a window of opportunity to make landings there, allowing Luke to conduct rallies without Imperial interference. Luke also used the ''Narrow Margin'' to travel to the small town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which typically harbored individuals more sympathetic to the Rebellion. During these rallies, Luke attempted to recruit Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for dangerous missions against the Empire. This included Operations [[Operation Corellian Butterfly|Corellian Butterfly]], [[Operation Free Will|Free Will]], [[Operation Brassvine|Brassvine]], [[Operation Weakest Link|Weakest Link]], [[Operation Calm Water|Calm Water]], [[Operation Bright Star|Bright Star]], [[Operation Shining Justice|Shining Justice]] and [[Operation Hope|Hope]].<ref name="SWG:operations" />

==Behind the scene==
The ''Narrow Margin'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:operations" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Narrow Margin'' was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," released on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref>

During periods of [[W:c:swg:Rebel Alliance|Rebel]] occupation, [[W:c:swg:Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]] would periodically land in this shuttle in the [[W:c:swg:City|cities]] of [[W:c:swg:Coronet|Coronet]] on [[W:c:swg:Corellia|Corellia]] and [[W:c:swg:Theed|Theed]] on [[W:c:swg:Naboo|Naboo]]. Because it was statically controlled by the Rebellion, the craft would also carry Luke to [[W:c:swg:Anchorhead|Anchorhead]] on [[W:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]]. During these visits, Luke would offer players of the Rebel [[W:c:swg:Faction|faction]] up to eight different [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]], half of which were designated as "Combatant" quests (to be carried out against Imperial non-player characters), and the other half of which were designated as "[[Special forces|Special Forces]]" quests (to be carried out against Imperial player characters). Luke would stay in these cities for a period of fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] before departing. During the craft's arrival and departure, nearby players received a system message from the ''Narrow Margin'' to flight control announcing the ship's arrival/departure.<ref name="SWG:operations" />

The graphical appearance of the ''Narrow Margin'' was identical to the one used for the generic passenger shuttles which carried players between connecting [[W:c:swg:Shuttleport|shuttle ports]] on various [[W:c:swg:Planet|worlds]]. In the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|game]], the passenger shuttles were evidently restricted to atmospheric travel (or at the very least, [[Orbit/Legends|suborbital]] flight). However, the ''Narrow Margin'' carried Luke to three different planet's, suggesting that it may have been a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] capable of interplanetary travel. However, this article refrains from making this assumption, as the possibility of it being carried to other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] by another craft cannot be completely ruled out.<ref name="SWG:operations" />
